messages:
mira: FYI found embed-batching regression for payloads >1k tokens; P95 doubled in canary logs. building hotfix image gcr.io/redwood/model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-rush and requesting expedited deploy.
release-manager: Need rollback criteria, change window, and approvals. Ops needs to +1.
kai: Change window until 03:00 UTC. Rollback if 5m error-rate >3% or token-P95 >800ms. I'll gate.
sre-oncall: Adding synthetic perf probe + KV-cache checks to canary checklist. smoke job: https://ci.internal/runs/emerald-rush-smoke
mira: Canary plan: 5% eu-west1 -> 25% -> 100% if green. will stream pod logs and traces.
infra-lead: +1 conditional on smoke and KV metrics.
release-manager: requesting two engineering +1s to skip extended hold.
kai: +1 if smoke passes and traces look normal.
dev-deploy-bot: deploybot: starting canary model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-rush -> prod (eu-west1) at 3800012345
dev-deploy-bot: canary pods ready (3/3). running smoke tests.
dev-deploy-bot: smoke-tests: passed 8/8. latency P95=420ms; errors=0.1%.
sre-oncall: KV hit-rate steady; synthetic probe green; dashboards look good.
release-manager: proceeding to 25% fastroll after approvals.
dev-deploy-bot: traffic increased to 25% at 3800012360. monitoring 15m window.
dev-deploy-bot: 25% window complete at 3800012380; metrics stable.
release-manager: final call - any veto?
sre-oncall: no veto. +1 final.
kai: +1 final. promote.
dev-deploy-bot: promoting model-serving:v2.1.3-emerald-rush to 100% at 3800012380
mira: rollout complete. posting changelog and release note to #releases.
release-manager: rollback playbook if thresholds breach: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=202` and open incident channel.
sre-oncall: I'll keep a 60m watch and update incident board if anything spikes.
